fieldValues.title: B2. Make sense
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: turn what was noticed into named meaning (domain, persona, problem, remedy, axes), so work has a why.

Tried: the method package; Suggestions, Affirmed and Set aside; domain containers, clusters, remedies with falsifiers; the trigram and compass axes; the decision taxonomy.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-off: human layer ↔ agent throughput. Agents generate meaning far faster than the owner affirms it; on 10-24 the answer moved to narrative first (SP-103, remedy 74a2cbd2).
- Gone wrong: affirmation is the choke point; affirming the pilot domains reappeared in five plans after it was done on 10-16; SP-101, SP-102; the axes exercise took two days and found 82 of 101 decisions inward (discoveries 13).
